Reference / async/timeout

async/timeout#

Structured monotonic deadlines for futures.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let request is Within<Response> = Within(
    origin: client.request(),
    limit: Duration(seconds: 5),
    clock: SystemClock(),
);
let response = await request.outcome();

Description#

Structured monotonic deadlines for futures.

Within<T> limits one future by an exact non-negative duration:

Before<T> uses an already computed MonotonicInstant. This is useful when several operations must share one deadline without each receiving a fresh relative timeout:

let deadline = clock.monotonic_instant().plus(budget);
let bounded is Before<Response> = Before(
    origin: client.request(),
    deadline: deadline,
    clock: clock,
);
let response = await bounded.outcome();

An origin which is already settled wins without starting a clock wait. When time wins, the origin is cancelled and its cleanup is awaited before TimedOut is thrown. Origin values and failures retain their identity when they win. Repeated outcome() calls return the same future.

Deadlines are monotonic runtime-local readings. Civil Instant values are deliberately not accepted and cannot be converted into timeout deadlines.
